name: Balsamic Portobello Burger with Caramelized Onions & Side Salad

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice the onion into half rings.
Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and caramelized, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 caps portobello mushrooms
½ head romaine lettuce
1 tomato
½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, and Italian seasoning. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
extra virgin olive oil
balsamic vinegar
1 tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Add to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, combine mayo, oil, Dijon, garlic powder, and salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the aioli and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
Dijon mustard
¼ tsp garlic powder
salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add mushrooms and cook until soft, 3-5 minutes per side. (Reserve bowl with leftover marinade for the next step.) When mushrooms are cooked, slice the cheese, place on top of mushroom caps, and reduce heat to low. Cover and let cook until cheese melts, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, and salt to the bowl with leftover marinade. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
balsamic vinegar
½ tsp honey
Dijon mustard
salt

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce leaves. Set aside 1 large leaf per burger; chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Medium dice half of the tomato and add to the salad bowl. Thinly slice remaining tomato and set aside.
Trim and medium dice the cucumber; add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
Toast buns if desired. Spread aioli on bottom half of each bun; layer with reserved lettuce, tomato, mushrooms, and caramelized onions. Close with the top half.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates and enjoy!
